class.name: DisVariableParameter
class.brief_description: Builds and reads the articulated and attached part records of entity PDUs.
class.description: Builds and reads the 16-byte variable parameter records that [DisEntityStatePdu], [DisEntityStateUpdatePdu] and [DisDetonationPdu] carry in [code]variable_parameters[/code] (IEEE 1278.1-2012 6.2.94). The two common kinds are articulated parts, the moving parts of an entity such as a turret's azimuth, a gun's elevation or a rotor's rotation, and attached parts, the stores on a station such as a missile under a wing. An articulated part's parameter type is a type class from SISO-REF-010 (a multiple of 32, for example 4096 [i]Primary Turret Number 1[/i], 4416 [i]Primary Gun Number 1[/i], 1184 [i]Main Rotor[/i]) plus a metric ([constant METRIC_AZIMUTH], [constant METRIC_ELEVATION], ...). Angles are radians, positions and extensions metres, and rates per second; the value is a 32-bit float on the wire. Names of classes, metrics and stations come from [code]DisEnums.get_enum_name()[/code] with the tables [code]articulated_part_class[/code], [code]articulated_part_metric[/code] and [code]attached_part[/code]. [codeblock] # Publish a turret and its gun with a DisEntity (a change is sent at once): entity.variable_parameters = [ DisVariableParameter.articulated_part(4096, DisVariableParameter.METRIC_AZIMUTH, turret_yaw), DisVariableParameter.articulated_part(4416, DisVariableParameter.METRIC_ELEVATION, gun_pitch, 1), ] # Read them from a remote entity: for part in DisVariableParameter.decode_all(remote.get_last_pdu().variable_parameters): if part.record_type == DisVariableParameter.RECORD_ARTICULATED_PART and part.type_class == 4096: turret.rotation.y = -part.value # DIS azimuth is clockwise seen from above [/codeblock] The layouts are checked against records packed from the standard ([code]tools/vp_golden.py[/code]) and Wireshark's DIS dissector.

method.name: articulated_part
method.description: Returns an articulated part record: parameter type [param type_class] + [param metric], value [param value] (32-bit float), on the part [param attached_to] (0 is the entity itself), with the change indicator [param change] (0-255; count it up whenever the part changes, receivers use it to see new values). Pushes an error and returns an empty array if [param type_class] is not a non-negative multiple of 32 or [param metric] is outside 0-31.

method.name: attached_part
method.description: Returns an attached part record: the part of type [param entity_type] (seven values as in [member DisEntityStatePdu.entity_type]) on station [param station] (SISO-REF-010 [i]Attached Parts[/i], for example 512 and up for fuselage stations), on the part [param attached_to], with the detached indicator [param detached]. Pushes an error and returns an empty array if [param entity_type] does not have seven values.

method.name: decode
method.description: Returns [param record] as a [Dictionary] with [code]record_type[/code]. Articulated parts add [code]change[/code], [code]attached_to[/code], [code]parameter_type[/code], [code]type_class[/code], [code]metric[/code] and [code]value[/code]; attached parts add [code]detached[/code] ([bool]), [code]attached_to[/code], [code]station[/code] and [code]entity_type[/code] ([PackedInt32Array]); other record types keep the 15 bytes after the type in [code]data[/code]. Pushes an error and returns an empty dictionary if [param record] is not 16 bytes.

method.name: decode_all
method.description: Returns [method decode] of every record in [param records] (a PDU's [code]variable_parameters[/code]). Entries that are not [PackedByteArray] are skipped with an error.
